data.credibility: Management generally delivers on stated guidance for revenue, margin, and hiring, successfully meeting targets in FY26. However, they lowered FY27 revenue guidance twice, showing occasional forecasting challenges during periods of slowing growth.

lines.line: Promised 2% to 3% revenue growth for FY26; delivered 3.1% in constant currency.
Guided 20% to 22% operating margin for FY26; achieved 23.7%.
Targeted 20,000 fresh hires for FY26; successfully delivered 20,000 employees.
Planned to recruit 20,000 college graduates next financial year; currently on track.
Guided FY27 revenue growth at 1.5% to 3.5%; status is slipping after being lowered.
Set FY27 operating margin guidance at 20% to 22%; currently on track at 23.7%.
Expected FY27 effective tax rates between 29% and 30%; currently on track.
Planned for 6,000 frontier engineers over the next few years; on track.
Expected net new mega deal to contribute over 1% growth in FY28; pending.

bull: Infosys boasts strong returns with an ROE of 31.9% and an impressive ROCE of 40.0%.
The company is nearly debt-free, with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09 against borrowings of ₹8,525 cr.
Operating cash flow has been robust at 110% of reported profit over the last 5 years.
bear: Revenue growth is decelerating, dropping to 6.8% a year over three years compared to 12.2% over five.
EBITDA margins have compressed from 27.8% in FY21 down to 23.7% in FY26.
FY27 revenue guidance had to be lowered twice during the year, reflecting ongoing forecasting headwinds.
